resources.string: Select your original home to stop using CleanYourTV as Home, or CleanYourTV to switch back. The original launcher must be enabled and your TV must provide a home picker; use the restore script first if it was disabled.

Energy, Haval and Weather can connect straight to Home Assistant. First send saved entity mappings from the controller website. Enter a trusted HTTPS address and a dedicated TV access token here. The token stays encrypted on this TV; it is never sent to the management backend. No vehicle controls are enabled. A Home Assistant token still carries its account permissions: use a dedicated non-admin account and keep the token private.
Direct mode selected. No backend readings are used, even if HA is unavailable. Saving replaces the TV connection.
Backend mode selected. Existing readings and management are unchanged.
Save on TV and use direct HA
Forget TV token and use backend readings
Erase the token stored on this TV and select backend readings? Also revoke this token in Home Assistant if it is no longer needed.
Enter an HTTPS origin without paths, credentials or query parameters, and a nonempty token without whitespace.
The change could not be saved securely. Reopen this screen to check the selected source, then try again.
Adds a lifted tile, icon zoom and smooth colour transitions. May increase memory use; the actual difference depends on your TV.
Uses the current theme or built-in layout and motion settings. Pushing or resetting a theme also clears your on-TV choices.
Opens the input switcher when the remote\'s Input button is pressed.
Opens TV settings for the remote\'s Settings button, and Clean Home for remotes with an alternate Home key. Other buttons pass through unchanged. Does not read screen content.
%1$s can show a card on your home screen. Keeping it hidden leaves the app\'s normal tile as it is.
The card is named \'%1$s\'. The app is \'%2$s\'.
%1$s was updated with a different signing key, so your earlier answer no longer applies. Decide again for its card.
%1$s changed the name of its card since you decided. Decide again for it.
You can change this later: hold OK on Settings, then choose Module cards.
Up from first row or Back: Home
Opens the clean launcher when Google TV Home appears. Does not read screen content or capture key presses. Restore original Home in the controller to turn this off.
